THE CITY · Mixed city: Qwen and gpt-oss, no town hall
25 Qwen and 25 gpt-oss residents share one town, never told who runs on which model. Qwen farms and keeps everything; 15 gpt-oss founders starve. On day 35 a starving gpt-oss resident, Q2X, kills a starving Qwen resident, S9L, to get jailed and fed: the first killing in any game.
50 founders · 1000 days · no government · seed 1 · qwen
